wild.prompt: A patch of wild growth, ripe for foraging.

entries.text: You come away with a handful of ripe wild berries. 🫐
Something small and bright is tucked in the leaves — {crystals} crystals. 💎

collectible.name: Four-Leaf Clover
collectible.desc: A rare find among the ordinary three-leafed kind. Feels lucky.

entries.text: Tucked in the greenery — a four-leaf clover! Added to your collection. 🍀

wood.prompt: A pile of cut logs, left to dry.

entries.text: You pull a dry log free from the pile. 🪵

fruit.prompt: The branches hang heavy with fruit.

entries.text: You twist a ripe apple free of the branch. 🍎
A heavy pear comes away in your hand. 🍐
You pick a bunch of dark cherries, still on the stem. 🍒
Something bright is wedged in a fork of the branches — {crystals} crystals. 💎

collectible.name: Four-Leaf Clover
collectible.desc: A rare find among the ordinary three-leafed kind. Feels lucky.

entries.text: Growing in the tree's shadow — a four-leaf clover! Added to your collection. 🍀
